answer: Each new key must publish one reproducible bug report for a randomly chosen open-source test harness; a maintainer reruns the exact steps against a fresh build and signs the unique issue hash only if it reproduces. The registry consumes that signature and rejects duplicate hashes or reports lacking the nadir/jade/pigment nonce. Proposed review fee is .70 per key, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .70 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,700 (1,000 × .70). Limitation: this favors technical contributors and reviewers can collude.
